name: Restaurant La Terrasse
description: A popular restaurant in Bastos offering French-Cameroonian fusion cuisine with a lovely outdoor terrace. Known for grilled meats and fresh seafood dishes.

name: Marché Central de Yaoundé
description: The bustling Central Market of Yaoundé, the largest market in the city. Fresh produce, spices, clothing, and local crafts. A vibrant cultural experience.

name: Marché Mokolo
description: One of the most famous and largest markets in Central Africa. An incredible sensory experience with thousands of vendors selling everything from food to electronics.

name: Restaurant Le Safoutier
description: Authentic Cameroonian cuisine featuring safou (bush butter) grilled with plantains and fish. A beloved local spot in the Tsinga neighborhood.

name: Musée National du Cameroun
description: The National Museum of Cameroon housed in the former presidential palace. Features traditional art, masks, instruments, and artifacts from across the country.

name: Monument de la Réunification
description: An iconic landmark of Yaoundé celebrating the reunification of Cameroon in 1961. Features a striking statue and offers panoramic views of the city.

name: Hôtel Hilton Yaoundé
description: A luxury hotel in Bastos district offering world-class amenities, a swimming pool, spa, and fine dining. Ideal for business and leisure travelers.

name: Café de Yaoundé
description: A cozy café in Hippodrome serving freshly roasted Cameroonian coffee, pastries, and light meals. A great spot for remote work or casual meetings.

name: Restaurant Wouri
description: Renowned for fresh fish dishes inspired by the coastal cuisine of Douala, served in a relaxed atmosphere in the heart of Yaoundé.

name: Marché du Lac
description: A lively neighborhood market near Lac Municipal. Great for fresh fruits, vegetables, and local street food like beignets and plantains.

name: Centre d'Art Camerounais
description: An art center showcasing contemporary Cameroonian painters, sculptors, and photographers. Regular exhibitions and workshops for visitors.

name: Restaurant Le Biniou
description: A charming French brasserie in Bastos offering classic dishes like escargot, coq au vin, and an excellent wine selection in an elegant setting.

name: Hôtel Résidence La Falaise
description: A comfortable mid-range hotel in Bastos with well-equipped rooms, a restaurant serving local and international cuisine, and reliable Wi-Fi.

name: Marché Madagascar
description: A vibrant open-air market known for affordable clothing, textiles, and imported goods from Asia. A treasure hunt for bargain shoppers.

name: Café des Arts
description: A trendy café and art gallery combo in the Nlongkak area. Serves artisanal coffee, fresh juices, and creative smoothie bowls in a stylish atmosphere.

name: Restaurant Le Palais de Biyem-Assi
description: A family-friendly restaurant offering generous portions of Cameroonian staples like ndolé, eru, and fufu with various meat accompaniments.

name: Monument de l'Indépendance
description: The Independence Monument at the heart of Yaoundé, a towering structure symbolizing Cameroon's freedom. Surrounded by green lawns and gardens.

name: Hôtel Le Méridien Président
description: A five-star hotel overlooking the Mfoundi valley. Features multiple restaurants, a rooftop pool, conference facilities, and luxurious rooms.

name: Café Mamba
description: A popular hangout spot for young professionals and students. Known for its energetic vibe, live music on weekends, and affordable local snacks.

name: Marché Gasy
description: A well-known market specializing in imported goods, electronics, and spare parts. The go-to place for affordable tech accessories and gadgets.

name: Restaurant Nguon
description: A beloved local eatery famous for its succulent grilled chicken (poulet DG) and traditional Bamileke dishes served with generous portions.

name: Jardin Botanique de Yaoundé
description: A peaceful botanical garden and research center managed by IRAD. Features diverse tropical plants, orchids, and a serene walking trail.

name: Résidence des Arts
description: A charming boutique guesthouse in Bastos decorated with local artworks. Offers cozy rooms, homemade breakfast, and a warm Cameroonian welcome.

name: Marché Nselen
description: A neighborhood market in Nselen known for its organic produce, medicinal herbs, and traditional remedies. A glimpse into Cameroonian herbal culture.

name: Restaurant Le Panier d'Afrique
description: An upscale pan-African restaurant featuring dishes from across the continent. Great ambiance with live saxophone music on Friday evenings.

name: Espace Culturel
description: A cultural space hosting rotating exhibitions, poetry readings, and cultural debates in a modern gallery space.

name: Café Bénédictine
description: A quiet café run by a local Benedictine community. Offers herbal teas, organic honey, and baked goods in a serene garden setting.

name: Restaurant La Paillote
description: A rustic thatched-roof restaurant serving traditional Cameroonian barbecue, bush meat (farmed), and palm wine. An authentic village experience.

name: Hôtel Ibis Yaoundé
description: A reliable budget-to-mid-range international hotel chain near the airport. Clean rooms, standard amenities, and free parking.

name: Marché Total
description: A modern market complex offering a cleaner shopping experience with organized sections for meat, fish, produce, and household items.
